promptZh: Why did young Chen Jin promise to build a bridge? 根据短文内容，选择最佳答案。

explanation.summaryZh: 上学的木桥摇摇晃晃、雨天河水上涨，孩子们只能手拉手慢慢过桥，因此她许下修桥的心愿。
explanation.ruleZh: 细节题：根据题干关键词回到原文定位对应句，对比选项即可确定答案。

evidence.quote: had to cross a shaky wooden bridge on her way to school

options.text: Her old wooden bridge was dangerous.
She wanted to win a prize.
Her school was too far away.
